executable_checks.command: Verify no floating point operations or random number generation in precompiles
executable_checks.notes: Ensure all operations are deterministic integer or fixed-point arithmetic

checklist.ok_if: Precompiled contracts at addresses 0x01-0x11 produce deterministic outputs for given inputs with fixed gas costs, using correct trusted setup parameters for KZG and BLS
checklist.not_ok_if: Precompiles produce non-deterministic outputs, have implementation bugs, or use incorrect trusted setup parameters, causing consensus divergence
checklist.notes: This check addresses PROP-PRECOMPILE-DETERMINISM-T2U3, marked UNREACHABLE: 'Precompiles use deterministic algorithms with no randomness or floating point. Non-determinism would cause immediate chain split.' Per EL-TRUST-006 and EL-TRUST-009, precompile correctness is critical for consensus. KZG and BLS depend on trusted setup parameters being correct (operational prerequisite). COMPONENT-012 critical component.

checklist.title: Verify that system contracts are called with correct parameters during block processing
detection_procedure: 1. Review processing:core/state_processor.go:260-400 to verify system contract calls occur before transaction execution
2. Confirm ProcessBeaconBlockRoot writes to 0x000F3df6D732807Ef1319fB7B8bB8522d0Beac02 (EIP-4788)
3. Confirm ProcessParentBlockHash writes to 0x0000F90827F1C53a10cb7A02335B175320002935 (EIP-2935)
4. Confirm ProcessWithdrawalQueue reads withdrawal requests correctly (EIP-7002)
5. Confirm ProcessConsolidationQueue reads consolidation requests correctly (EIP-7251)
6. Test that incorrect parameters or skipped calls cause state root mismatch

executable_checks.command: Execute block and verify beacon root is written to correct system contract address
executable_checks.notes: Validate EIP-4788 implementation for trustless light clients

executable_checks.command: Execute block and verify parent block hash is written correctly
executable_checks.notes: Validate EIP-2935 implementation for stateless clients

executable_checks.command: Verify system contract addresses are hardcoded and calls are made before transactions
executable_checks.notes: Ensure no conditional logic can skip system contract calls

checklist.ok_if: System contracts are called with correct ABI and parameters during block processing (beacon root, parent hash, withdrawals, consolidations), with hardcoded addresses and deterministic execution
checklist.not_ok_if: System contracts called with incorrect parameters, skipped entirely, or called at wrong time, causing consensus divergence
checklist.notes: This check addresses PROP-SYSTEM-CONTRACT-CALLS-U4V5, marked UNREACHABLE: 'System contract calls are hardcoded in state processor with fixed addresses and ABIs. Divergence would be a consensus bug causing chain split.' Per EL-TRUST-011 and EL-FLOW-002, system contracts bridge EL to CL state. Critical for light clients (EIP-4788), stateless clients (EIP-2935), and validator operations (EIP-7002/7251). COMPONENT-009.

checklist.title: Verify that dangerous RPC namespaces are restricted by default configuration
detection_procedure: 1. Review config:node/node.go:118-120 to verify default HTTP API whitelist includes only eth, net, web3
2. Confirm that admin, debug, personal namespaces require explicit --http.api flag
3. Verify that HTTP requests to non-whitelisted namespaces are rejected with 'method not found'
4. Confirm that IPC transport (local socket) has no namespace restrictions (trusted local access)
5. Test that the default configuration prevents access to dangerous methods over HTTP

executable_checks.command: Start Geth with default config and attempt to call admin_addPeer over HTTP, verify rejection
executable_checks.notes: Confirm admin namespace not exposed by default

executable_checks.command: Start Geth with default config and attempt to call debug_traceBlock over HTTP, verify rejection
executable_checks.notes: Confirm debug namespace not exposed by default

executable_checks.command: Verify documentation warns about security risks of --http.api=admin,debug,personal
executable_checks.notes: Ensure operators are informed of risks when explicitly exposing dangerous namespaces

checklist.ok_if: Default HTTP API configuration exposes only safe read-only namespaces (eth, net, web3), with admin/debug/personal requiring explicit --http.api flag and documentation warnings
checklist.not_ok_if: Admin, debug, or personal namespaces accessible over HTTP by default, or can be accessed without explicit operator configuration
checklist.notes: This check addresses PROP-RPC-NAMESPACE-ACCESS-CONTROL-V6W7, marked UNREACHABLE with default config: 'Admin/debug namespaces are not exposed over HTTP by default. Reachable only if operator explicitly configures --http.api=admin,debug,personal (operational misconfiguration).' Per EL-TRUST-012 and ACTOR-005, RPC clients are Untrusted. This validates DEFAULT security, not misconfiguration scenarios. COMPONENT-002.

checklist.title: Verify that RPC query limits prevent DoS through expensive queries
detection_procedure: 1. Review limits:internal/ethapi/api.go:180+ to verify --rpc.gascap default (50M gas) is enforced on eth_call
2. Confirm --rpc.logquerylimit default (10000 logs) is enforced on eth_getLogs
3. Verify --rpc.evmtimeout default (5s) is enforced on expensive operations
4. Test that queries exceeding limits are rejected or clamped to safe values
5. Confirm that sustained high-rate queries can be mitigated at infrastructure level (firewall, rate limiting)

executable_checks.command: Call eth_call with gas limit exceeding --rpc.gascap and verify it's clamped to cap
executable_checks.notes: Confirm gas cap prevents unbounded execution in read-only queries

executable_checks.command: Call eth_getLogs with wide block range exceeding result limit and verify rejection
executable_checks.notes: Validate log query limit prevents memory exhaustion

executable_checks.command: Call expensive operation and verify timeout after 5 seconds (default --rpc.evmtimeout)
executable_checks.notes: Confirm timeout prevents hanging queries

checklist.ok_if: RPC endpoints enforce query limits (50M gas cap, 10000 log limit, 5s timeout) to bound resource consumption, with defaults providing DoS mitigation for legitimate use cases
checklist.not_ok_if: Query limits can be bypassed or are insufficient, allowing single queries to cause node hang or memory exhaustion
checklist.notes: This check addresses PROP-RPC-RATE-LIMITS-W8X9, marked PARTIALLY REACHABLE: 'Attackers can submit expensive queries but are bounded by default limits. Sustained attacks require multiple connections/IPs.' This is a liveness property (DoS resistance) not safety. Per ACTOR-005 and COMPONENT-002, RPC clients are Untrusted. Limits balance usability with security.
